_about: Crop library for the twin (CLAUDE.md step 4). Values from FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Allen et al. 1998) Tables 11, 12, 14, 22 and 24, read on fao.org on 2026-11-12 (Chapter 6: https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm; Chapter 8: https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm), and FAO-66 (Steduto et al. 2012) Table 1 (https://www.fao.org/4/i2800e/i2800e02.pdf). FAO-56 has no Nepal rows: stage lengths are the closest listed analog and need local checking. Where FAO gives a range, the value used and why are in the source text. null = not published in any source opened: TODO-VERIFY. Rules for choosing within ranges: Zr uses the larger value ('for modeling soil water stress or for rainfed conditions', Table 22 footnote 1); a blank Kc ini takes its crop group's value ('representative of the whole group', Table 12 text). Calendars: FAO Crop Calendar for Nepal's Hill agro-ecological zone (incl. Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur). Stage lengths of rice, wheat, maize, lentil and finger millet are scaled in proportion to the local growing period (the midpoint of the default calendar window's days; largest-remainder rounding, pipeline/twin/crops.py scale_stages; REVIEW_NOTES H4, 2026-11-12); FAO-56's own rows are kept in stages_fao56. Potato's FAO-56 length (115 d) already lies in its window (100-120 d) and is not scaled. Mustard and buckwheat have no FAO-56 stage lengths: they carry simulate false, with the reason in sources.simulate, and the twin runs only crops with complete parameters (pipeline/twin/crops.py simulatable_crops). Ky: crops with no published seasonal Ky carry an owner-assumed neutral 1.0 (ky_assumed true; owner decision 2026-11-12).

sources.stages_days: FAO-56 Table 11, Rice 30/30/60/30 = 150 d ('Tropics; Mediterranean'), scaled in proportion to the local growing period 110 d (midpoint of 100-120 d, FAO Crop Calendar Hill zone) = 22/22/44/22. FAO-56 Table 11 note: lengths are 'indicative' and 'The user is strongly encouraged to obtain appropriate local information'. Scaling rule: Claude's choice, owner-approved 2026-11-12, step-4 review item 5
sources.kc: FAO-56 Table 12, Rice: Kc ini 1.05 (Table 14: sub-humid to humid, light wind = 1.05), Kc mid 1.20, Kc end '0.90-0.60'; 0.75 is the midpoint (Claude's choice, owner-approved 2026-11-12, step-4 review item 5)
sources.zr_m: FAO-56 Table 22, Rice 0.5-1.0 m; larger value (footnote 1)
sources.p: FAO-56 Table 22, Rice 0.20, footnote 4 'of saturation'. Our bucket applies it to TAW between field capacity and wilting point: a simplification
sources.ky: ASSUMED, not published: owner decision 2026-11-12 (step-4 review item 4) - neutral Ky 1.0 assumed (harvest falls in step with water shortage), labelled 'assumed' wherever it is used. Sensitivity runs use Ky 0.8 and 1.2 (config/rules.yaml ky_assumed). Why assumed: no seasonal Ky for rice in FAO-56 Table 24, FAO-66 Tables 1-2 or the FAO crop-information pages; FAO-33 itself could not be opened. A peer-reviewed seasonal rice Ky replaces it, with its citation, if one is found. Search for a published value continues: TODO-VERIFY

sources.stages_days: FAO-56 Table 11, Lentil, planting Oct/Nov, 'Arid Region': 25/35/70/40 = 170 d (closest planting date; local check needed), scaled in proportion to the local growing period 133 d (midpoint 132.5 of 120-145 d, FAO Crop Calendar Hill zone, rounded up to a whole day: Claude's choice) = 20/27/55/31 (largest-remainder rounding). FAO-56 Table 11 note: lengths are 'indicative' and 'The user is strongly encouraged to obtain appropriate local information'. Scaling: the rule used for rice and wheat, applied by owner decision 2026-11-12 (REVIEW_NOTES H4)
